---
title: "Research"
---


## Current projects

- Integrating electronic health records (EHRs) and randomized controlled trials (RCTs) using Bayesian adaptive borrowing methods and inverse propensity weighting.
- Examining the utility of randomizing assessment timing across individuals in longitudinal studies.
- Using principal stratification to investigate mode effects in surveys.
- Analyzing life history data and addressing missingness in grid-based data.

## Current collaborative projects

- Generating and evaluating synthetic data.
- Using multi-agent large language models to analyze open-ended survey responses.
- Collaborating with clinicians to study rehabilitation outcomes and adherence among older adults with chronic conditions, as well as psychosocial factors and resilience in cardiovascular health.

## Future directions

- Integrating population surveys covering different life stages.
